summary: 1–2, The keys of the kingdom of God are committed to man on earth, and the gospel cause will triumph; 3–6, The millennial kingdom of heaven will come and join the kingdom of God on earth.
meta_description: Revelation on prayer given through Joseph Smith the Prophet, at Hiram, Ohio, October 30, 1831.
